references.use: PFS mount/unmount option layout and API signatures; pfsmgr sealed-key ioctl; PS4 companion key and PS5 container key locations. No original-container mounting, network command server, restore, or save creation code is carried over.
Existing staged-copy workflow, bounded heap ioctl key buffer, temporary save-service authid/capabilities and verified credential restoration.

implementation: ProsperoMenu isolates each operation in its own helper with durable intent and completion receipts. Installed saves are opened read-only. Exported PAX tar archives contain file hashes and a manifest; they are published only after staged-copy unmount and archive verification. USB selection binds a mounted volume identity. Unknown mount/publication state retains staging instead of replaying.
